'''2014 European Championship Reset Beta Dennis Schwarz DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Dennis Schwarz]] at [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Dennis Schwarz]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[According to My Design]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-europeans-reset-beta-event-15th-place-ds-dennis-schwarz-aobs/ PC list]
